name: 2fa
description: TOTP code generator and storage. Do not use this on anything serious!

Subcommands:.now: Generates a code given a key once off: [36m[3m[1m2fa[0m[3m now[0m
Subcommands:.add: Adds a key to the storage, retreivable with the given label: [36m[3m[1m2fa[0m[3m add <label>
Subcommands:.remove: Removes a key from the storage: [36m[3m[1m2fa[0m[3m remove <label>
Subcommands:.get: Generates a code given a key from the storage: [36m[3m[1m2fa[0m[3m get <label>
Subcommands:.list: Lists all keys in the storage: [36m[3m[1m2fa[0m[3m list [-k]

For add:.label: Label to store the key under. Should be unique. Spaces are not allowed. Case sensitive.

For remove:.label: Label of the key to remove. Case sensitive.

For get:.label: Label of the key to generate a code for. Case sensitive.

For list:.-k: Show the keys alongside their labels.
